linkedin.text:
Peak replacement season is when the money question gets real. A roof replacement is a five-figure expense that rarely arrives when savings are flush, and what 10+ years on Portland metro roofs taught us is that homeowners don't need a pitch, they need the paperwork translated.

So here's the translation. Most 0% promotional offers are deferred-interest structures: pay the full balance inside the window and you pay zero, exactly as advertised. Miss it, and interest often applies retroactively to the original amount. The strategy is to divide the total by the months, automate the payment, and finish a month early. And five questions sort every offer, ours included: deferred interest or not, the rate after, fees and prepayment penalties, whether the minimum payment actually retires the balance, and whether the contractor's price changes with financing. Ours doesn't.

The full guide is on our site, and the roof assessment is free: https://www.frenchroofing.com/estimate

gmb: Peak replacement season is when the money question gets real, so here's how roof financing actually works. French Roofing partners with Enhancify, which connects homeowners to lending options including 0% promotional offers. You apply once and get matched with lenders; checking your options uses a soft credit pull, so shopping doesn't affect your score. Most 0% offers are deferred-interest structures: pay the full balance within the promotional window and you pay zero interest. Miss it, and interest often applies retroactively to the original amount. The safe play is to divide the total by the months, automate that payment, and finish a month early. Before signing anything, ask whether the offer is deferred interest, what the standard rate is afterward, whether there are origination fees or prepayment penalties, and whether the contractor's price changes with financing. Ours doesn't: same crew, same materials, same warranty whether you pay cash, card, or financed, and larger repairs can use the same program.
